_comment: SKU to Scene two-tier LTO workflow (ComfyUI API format). Draft on LTX-2.5 Fast, then hero on Kling v3 Pro image-to-video from the approved cup image. Simulated unless SKU2SCENE_MODE=live.

inputs.prompt: Storyboard draft 'First Frost Commute': frosty city morning, a commuter lifts a Northwind Pumpkin Cold Brew, breath visible, slow push-in. Vertical 9:16 social cut.

Cinematic close-up of the Northwind Pumpkin Cold Brew cup: cold brew pours over ice, pumpkin cream cascades, condensation beads, slow dolly-in, golden-hour rim light. Native audio: ice clinking and pour.
